name: Pi Coding Agent: A Self-Documenting, Extensible AI Partner - DEV Community
description: Meta-lesson: One of Pi's most powerful features is that you can ask it to explain itself. The agent can read its own documentation, investigate its codebase, and help you extend or modify its behavior—all through natural conversation.
